task: Positive-unlabelled LANL authentication event-group retrieval, research only
source_scope: CC0, A. D. Kent, 2015, doi:10.17021/1179829. Clock in relative seconds. No authentication outcomes as features.
scope: One group per second, human-form source principal, source device and destination device. All eligible orientations included. Apply all updates after scoring entire second; quarantine last incomplete second of a truncated prefix. Warm up through second 43199, choose fixed strict cutoff at <=1% unlabelled-reference alert volume on [43200,86400), score [86400,259200) or available complete prefix. No identity or literals in persisted feature data. Evaluate separate resource-popularity, first actor-target and context-conditioned destination surprisal. No negative labels. No HTTP equivalence.
conditional: Empirical Bayes destination estimate: equal mixture of actor and source-machine histories, each shrunk by 8 observations to globally smoothed destination frequency.
